name: mirage
text: Two jobs, both running. (A) Disappearing bets. You're on 1.0.73, so the logger is already on your phone. It has recorded nothing about this yet, because your report was made a moment after you installed it. Leave the +EV tab open and let the bets vanish and return 3 or 4 times, about 3 minutes. Then send a fresh diagnostics report. Its FEEDHIDE lines will name the check that hid each bet and the ages of its odds. I read it as soon as it arrives. If they rest on stale odds, I'll make them not show at all. In the meantime I'm reading the code for what makes the whole list drop together, since that's what you see. (B) Fixes from the report. The two real ones are the big bets.json and light-bids.json files, which I'm building now with an archive for old settled records. The Kalshi 400s were already fixed. The Pinnodds key is spent until its reset. The wrong 'switched off' wording is fixed in the next release.
